headline: Chickens Stay on Top as Demons and Hurricanes Surge Up the Board
lede: I'm told the Chickens are rolling, with a 9-game winning streak and a perfect 6-0 mark over the last three weeks. Boom, they stay on top of this Pecking Order. Money is nice, but championships are better, and this group looks built for both.

rankings.blurb: 6-0 over their last six at 189.8 PPG. Riding a 9-game winning streak. Pecking order: up 6 from #7.
Demons jumped 11 spots to #2 on the strength of a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks and a 3-game winning streak. League sources tell me they are the most dangerous riser in this top group.
Hurricanes climbed 7 spots, going 5-1 over the last three weeks with a 4-game winning streak and 173.9 points per game in that span. Boom, that is a team that is peaking at the right time.
Cellmates have won 10 straight, the longest active win streak in the league, and went 6-0 over the last three weeks. Their 72.4% all-play rate says this run is no fluke.
Razerbacks dropped 3 spots despite a 6-0 mark over the last three weeks and an 8-game winning streak. I'm told the all-play numbers still scream contender, so they are a bounce-back candidate.
Yeti's surged 10 spots into the top six with a 5-1 record over the last three weeks and 165.8 points per game in that stretch. Their 69.2% all-play rate backs up the jump.

Kraken climbed 10 spots after a perfect 6-0 run over the last three weeks, averaging 187.1 points per game during it. Their 58.2% all-play rate is the lowest of this group, so the question is whether the scoring holds up.
SnakeEyes rose 10 spots on a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks and 171.1 points per game in that span. Their 65.0% all-play rate says they are legit.
Badgers moved up 3 spots with a 5-1 record over the last three weeks and a 67.3% all-play rate. Quietly, they are one of the more consistent teams in the league.
Monsters fell 4 spots after a 2-4 stretch over the last three weeks and a 4-game losing streak. Their 67.7% all-play rate is still strong, so they need to fix the scoring fast.

Gladiators jumped 19 spots, the biggest climb on this list, with a 4-2 record over the last three weeks and a 2-game winning streak. They also dropped 185.22 points this week, the highest score in the league.

Tombstones slipped 1 spot despite the best all-play rate in the top 25 at 74.1%. A 2-4 mark over the last three weeks and a 2-game losing streak are the problem, and I'm told the scoring has dried up.
Barracudas climbed 9 spots on a 5-1 record over the last three weeks and a 4-game winning streak. Their 160.7 points per game in that stretch shows real momentum.
RailRoaders dropped 5 spots despite a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks and a 4-game winning streak. Their 152.4 points per game in that span is the lowest among the teams with winning streaks.
Hoosiers held steady at #15 with a 5-1 record over the last three weeks and a 3-game winning streak. Their 69.2% all-play rate keeps them firmly in the mix.

Tigers plunged 15 spots from #1 after going 3-3 over the last three weeks and scoring 146.9 points per game. League sources tell me this is the biggest fall in the top 25, and they need answers quickly.

Crushers dropped 9 spots after a 4-2 record over the last three weeks, but they averaged just 144.9 points per game in that stretch. Their 68.9% all-play rate says the record is better than the scoring.
Assassins climbed 6 spots with a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks and a 2-game winning streak. Their 69.4% all-play rate is one of the best in this group.
Monkeys crashed 16 spots from #3 despite a 5-1 record over the last three weeks and a 5-game winning streak. Their 61.4% all-play rate is the main reason for the drop.
Moose climbed 3 spots with a perfect 6-0 run over the last three weeks and a 6-game winning streak. Their 55.1% all-play rate is the lowest in the top 25, so the wins are coming with luck.
Nemesis plunged 17 spots from #4 after a 4-2 record over the last three weeks and 151.3 points per game in that span. Their 62.1% all-play rate tells me the fall is not complete yet.
Tikis dipped 1 spot after a 2-4 stretch over the last three weeks and a 2-game losing streak. Their 65.1% all-play rate is solid, but the scoring has to come back.
Spiders climbed 6 spots on a 4-2 record over the last three weeks and a 3-game winning streak. Their 59.7% all-play rate is the reason I am skeptical of the jump.
Banditos jumped 12 spots with a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks and a 3-game winning streak. Their 59.0% all-play rate says this is a team on the rise but not yet elite.

Jockeys surged 17 spots, the second-biggest climb on this list, with a 5-1 record over the last three weeks and a 2-game winning streak. Their 58.5% all-play rate is the lowest here, so they need to prove the rise is real.

statOfWeek.title: Stat of the Week
statOfWeek.blurb: Gladiators dropped 185.22 points, the highest score in the league this week. League sources tell me that is a statement performance.

benchBlunder.title: Bench Blunder of the Week
benchBlunder.blurb: Stingers left 43.68 points on the bench, scoring 95.89 when the optimal lineup was 139.57. Boom, that is a costly mistake you can avoid with the Lineup Optimizer.

heaterOfWeek.title: Heater of the Week
heaterOfWeek.blurb: Cellmates have won 10 straight, the longest active win streak in the league. I'm told this team is playing with total confidence.

coolerOfWeek.title: Cooler of the Week
coolerOfWeek.blurb: Bears have dropped 12 in a row, the longest active losing streak in the league. League sources tell me they need a serious reset.

matchupOfWeek.title: Matchup of the Week
matchupOfWeek.blurb: Week 7 brings #9 Badgers at #7 Kraken, the highest-ranked clash on the slate. Money is nice, but championships are better, and this one has playoff implications.
